pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sabbapaṃsukūliko susāne viharati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.3: so manussehi dīyamānaṃ na icchati paṭiggahetuṃ susānepi rukkhamūlepi ummārepi ayyavosāṭitakāni sāmaṃ gahetvā paribhuñjati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu amhākaṃ ayyavosāṭitakāni sāmaṃ gahetvā paribhuñjissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.6: theroyaṃ bhikkhu vaṭharo manussamaṃsaṃ maññe khādatī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.7: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.8: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti;
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.9: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āharissatī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.10: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āharasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.13: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa, adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āharissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.15: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.16.1: “yo pana bhikkhu adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āhareyya, pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:1.17: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū udakadantapone kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:2.2: bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhu āmantesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:2.4: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:2.5.1: “yo pana bhikkhu adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āhareyya aññatra udakadantaponā pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:3.1.8: kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā nissaggiyena vā dente hatthapāse ṭhito kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā patigaṇhāti etaṃ dinnaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:3.1.10: udakadantaponaṃ ṭhapetvā yaṃ kiñci ajjhoharaṇīyaṃ eso āhāro nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:3.2.1: apaṭiggahitake apaṭiggahitakasaññī adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āharati aññatra udakadantaponā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:3.2.2: apaṭiggahitake vematiko adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āharati aññatra udakadantaponā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:3.2.3: apaṭiggahitake paṭiggahitakasaññī adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āhāreti, aññatra udakadantaponā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc40:3.3.3: cattāri mahāvikaṭāni sati paccaye asati kappiyakārake sāmaṃ gahetvā paribhuñjati,
